body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2008') -- <Visual News> LG Electronics unveiled its 3-inch full touchscreen phone 'LG-SU100' equipped with the Franklin planner during KES 2008. The Franklin planner, a time management system, consists of a ring binder holding specially designed loose leaf pages. Divided by monthly tabs between the pages and accepting a wide variety of specialized accessories and inserts, the core idea is to consolidate tasks and appointments along with personal records in one place, methodically eliminating floating pieces of paper. Other features included OLED display, a 3M camera, electronic dictionary, S-DMB, global roaming, Bluetooth, web viewer and more. The LG-SU100 is expected to be available in Korea market in this year via SK Telecom.
